text:
maya: noticed examples/dataflow/README.md still recommends `REDWOOD_API_KEY` and uses the old python ctor. copy/paste footgun.

maya: snippet in README:
```
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-REDACTED
python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
resp = client.generate('Summarize this dataset')
print(resp.text)
```

jon: ugh. that will break new users. do we have any automation catching this?

maya: not in examples repo. slipped during last docs bulk update.

kevin: I'll open a small PR to replace with `.env` placeholder, use `REDWOOD_KEY`, switch to `create_completion` and show safe placeholder `REDACT_ME`. also add a grep lint to CI that fails on `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/pull/433

rachel: please also normalize the returned field name across languages in quickstarts. node examples still return `{ text }` while python returns `.content`. for clarity quickstart should show "completion_text" as the conceptual output and then language notes map to concrete fields.

kevin: good call. will add a tiny note and a follow-up issue to add snippet smoke tests (imports + function name check) so we catch API drift. filed issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/issues/211

ci-bot: [CI] examples-lint job failed on commit 7ff2a1: examples/dataflow/README.md contains forbidden token pattern `REDWOOD_API_KEY` - see https://ci.redwood.dev/8888/logs

kevin: expected. fixing now, switching to `REDWOOD_KEY` and placeholders, updating method and response handling.

docs-bot: docs-pr-reviewer assigned rachel to PR 433

rachel: left one tiny copy edit on wording. also add a one-liner in CONTRIBUTING.md about not pasting real secrets in examples, saw a SA json earlier.

kevin: added CONTRIBUTING note and `.env.example`. CI green, merging in a few minutes.
